paper_notes: Streaming vector addition is a memory-bandwidth-bound reference.
SAXPY is a streaming vector update with low arithmetic intensity.
Random gather is an irregular latency-sensitive memory workload.
Reduction is a bandwidth-sensitive parallel primitive with synchronization phases.
Block-local scan is a prefix primitive with synchronization and streaming data movement.
Matrix transpose is a data-layout transformation dominated by memory movement.
GEMV is a matrix-vector workload with lower reuse than GEMM and direct SAIT PIMSimulator GEMV coverage.
Current hand-written tiled GEMM has high data reuse, so it is a negative control for naive PIM offload.
cuBLAS SGEMM is used as an optimized compute-throughput and high-reuse reference.
